title: Dependency advisory exceptions
objective: Remove or re-review the two temporary advisory exceptions before they expire.
context_summary: The dependency audit tolerates two maintenance advisories in the pinned Iced and Metal stacks, each with a UTC expiry and an open task here. The audit fails when an exception expires or its task is retired.

tasks.description: Remove or re-review the temporary ttf-parser maintenance exception before 2026-10-29.
extra_context: RUSTSEC-2026-0192 on registry ttf-parser 0.25.1, through fontdb 0.23.0 in the Iced text stack and owned_ttf_parser 0.25.1/ab_glyph in winit's Linux Wayland decorations. The enforced review is 2026-09-29 and expires exclusively on 2026-10-29 UTC, as exceptions() in xtask/src/policy.rs records. fontdb 0.24.0 drops ttf-parser and cosmic-text main uses it, but released cosmic-text 0.19.0 still requires fontdb 0.23; pinned Iced 0.14.0 uses cosmic-text 0.15.0. The current RustSec advisory lists no patched version. No supported lockfile-only update removes both paths. The audit enforces the exact resolved version/registry source, a review window of at most 90 days and this task remaining open. Re-review sooner for published security details, compatible upstream adoption, distribution or font-input scope changes.

tasks.description: Remove or re-review the temporary paste maintenance exception before 2026-12-18.
extra_context: RUSTSEC-2024-0436 on registry paste 1.0.15, a build-time proc macro through metal 0.32.0 and wgpu-hal 27.0.4 in wgpu 27.0.1. The enforced review is 2026-09-19 and expires exclusively on 2026-12-18 UTC, as exceptions() in xtask/src/policy.rs records. Released metal 0.33.0 still requires paste; wgpu 30.0.1 uses objc2-metal instead, but that major renderer change is not a compatible update of the pinned Iced/wgpu stack. The audit enforces expiry, exact resolved version/registry source, a review window of at most 90 days and this task remaining open. Review sooner for new security information or a change to the pinned stack.
